units.function: Singleton facade that loads manifest Tools for ready plugins, listens to plugin lifecycle events, projects Agent descriptors and delegates execution to the in-memory Plugin Tool Registry.
units.dependencyDirection: Depends on Paperclip plugin database records, lifecycle manager, worker manager, global registry, plugin SDK types and logger. Tool Gateway and other internal callers consume it.
units.keyDataModels: Plugin database UUID, pluginKey, manifest Tool declaration, Agent Tool descriptor and ToolRunContext/ToolResult.
units.lifecycle: Loads ready plugins at startup, asynchronously registers an enabled plugin from the database, unregisters on disable/unload, retains entries during teardown and forwards discovery/execution.
units.testAssessment: The only focused suite passes 6 tests for UUID worker routing, missing-id failure, repeated registration and simulated worker bounce. Its claimed lifecycle test bypasses initialize, database lookup and event emission, so enable/disable ordering, partial startup, stale teardown and reconciliation are untested.
units.designRationale: Centralize plugin Tool discovery/routing and repair the distinction between stable manifest key and UUID-keyed worker identity.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs a tenant-scoped, versioned Connector capability registry with health/attestation, lifecycle reconciliation and explicit execution contracts across equal vendors.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE the separation between stable external key and opaque runtime identity, namespaced discovery and lifecycle-driven registration idea. Implement a durable/versioned capability projection with generation checks, tenant scope, reconciliation and Company OS Connector capability fields.
units.responsibilityConflict: The global descriptor omits risk, data scope, approval/cancel/idempotency, health and attestation. Fire-and-forget enable can re-register after disable, errors are log-only, and the facade contains no human/contract/data authority or evidence semantics.

units.function: Global in-memory namespaced Tool index and worker RPC router derived from plugin manifests.
units.dependencyDirection: Depends on Paperclip manifest and plugin-SDK execution types plus the worker manager; dispatcher owns it and exposes an escape hatch to callers.
units.keyDataModels: RegisteredTool indexed by pluginKey:toolName, plugin database UUID, parameter JSON Schema, ToolRunContext and ToolResult.
units.lifecycle: Replaces a plugin's registrations, lists/resolves entries, checks worker liveness and forwards executeTool RPC to the UUID-keyed worker.
units.testAssessment: UUID routing receives focused regression coverage, but no dedicated tests cover claimed schema validation, duplicate declarations, staged replacement, mutable references, tenant/run authority, worker-generation races, result validation, timeouts or errors.
units.designRationale: Provide low-complexity O(1) Tool lookup and idempotent manifest-derived registration without database persistence.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs canonical Connector capability ownership and dispatch that stays correct under upgrade, disable, multi-tenant concurrency and untrusted Connector inputs/outputs.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE deterministic namespacing and two-index lookup only. Replace with immutable/versioned capability snapshots, staged validate-and-swap, tenant scope, worker generation/fencing and Connector execution contracts.
units.responsibilityConflict: Despite documentation, parameters are never schema-validated; arbitrary input and caller-supplied run context are forwarded. Returned live entries are mutable, availability has a check/use race, and there is no timeout, cancellation, idempotency, data egress, approval, attestation or evidence boundary.

units.function: Focused regression tests for propagating plugin database UUID through Dispatcher/Registry into worker liveness and RPC routing.
units.dependencyDirection: Uses mocked worker/lifecycle collaborators and the production Dispatcher/Registry; no real database, lifecycle service or worker process participates.
units.keyDataModels: Manifest pluginKey, plugin database UUID, namespaced Tool and mocked ToolRunContext.
units.lifecycle: Registers, executes, unregisters/re-registers and toggles mocked worker availability.
units.testAssessment: All 6 tests passed locally. They correctly protect one historical identity-plumbing defect, but the lifecycle section is not an actual lifecycle-event test and createDbStub is unused. Broad Dispatcher/Registry claims remain uncovered.
units.designRationale: Prevent regression from UUID-keyed worker lookup back to manifest-key lookup.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS compatibility tests must bind stable Connector identity, installation identity and runtime generation without confusing them.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the identity-distinction regression as one Connector compatibility case, then add real enable/disable races, upgrade generations, reconciliation, schema/result validation and tenant/authority tests.
units.responsibilityConflict: Fixtures cast through unknown and carry no accountable human, permissions, data contract, execution attestation or evidence semantics.
